title: A Trip to Iceland
text:
Anna went to Iceland last summer. She wanted to see waterfalls and hot springs. She took a small bus with a group of tourists. The guide told them many stories about the land.

On the third day, the group hiked to a big glacier. The weather was cold, so everyone wore warm coats. At the end, Anna took many photos and bought a map. She said it was the best trip of her life.

questions.text: Where did Anna go last summer?
What did the group hike to on the third day?
Why did everyone wear warm coats?
options: Because they were going to a party

questions.text: What can we infer about Anna's trip?
options: She did not like the guide
She was bored all the time

vocabulary.definition: places where water falls down from a high rock or cliff
a very large mass of slowly moving ice
a person who shows people around a place and explains it
long warm clothes worn over other clothes outdoors

paragraph_translations: Anna pojechała na Islandię w zeszłe lato. Chciała zobaczyć wodospady i gorące źródła. Wsiadła do małego autobusu z grupą turystów. Przewodnik opowiadał im wiele historii o tej ziemi.

Trzeciego dnia grupa wędrowała do dużego lodowca. Pogoda była zimna, więc wszyscy mieli ciepłe płaszcze. Na końcu Anna zrobiła wiele zdjęć i kupiła mapę. Powiedziała, że to była najlepsza podróż w jej życiu.
